bashkit.tool_help_head:
# Bash

Run bash commands in an isolated virtual filesystem.

**Version:** 0.19.0
**Name:** `bashkit`
**Locale:** `en-US`

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `commands` | string | yes | — | Bash commands to execute |
| `timeout_ms` | integer | no | — | Per-call timeout in milliseconds |

## Result

| Field | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `stdout` | string | Standard output |
| `stderr` | string | Standard error |
| `exit_code` | integer | Shell exit code |
| `error` | string | Error category when execution fails |

## Examples

```json
{"commands":"echo hello"}
```

```json
{"commands":"echo data > /tmp/f.txt && cat /tmp/f.txt","timeout_ms":5000}
```

## Behavior

- Filesystem is virtual and isolated per execution.
- Standard bash syntax is supported, including pipes, redirects, loops, functions, and arrays.
- Builtins available by default: `echo printf cat read grep sed awk jq head tail sort uniq cut tr wc nl paste column comm diff strings tac rev cd pwd ls find mkdir mktemp rm rmdir cp mv touch chmod chown ln file stat less tar gzip gunzip bzip2 bunzip2 bzcat du df test [ true false exit return break continue export set unset local shift source eval declare typeset readonly shopt getopts sleep date seq expr yes wait timeout xargs tee watch basename dirname realpath pushd popd dirs whoami hostname uname id env printenv history curl wget od xxd hexdump base64 kill`
